method.output: Actual 1080x1920 production native RGBA readback at pinned V5 camera frame249
method.sampleSelection: Native PRIMARY coverage>=254/255, outside every protected box and native Boundary/Glow pixel; perpendicular production-segment profiles excluding nearby nonadjacent segments and vertices
method.width: Paired actual native terrain + core-only Event draws. Recover compositing alpha from RGB; integrate perpendicular profiles and interpolate half configured alpha crossings. Full finite halo measured separately.
method.widthClarification: Configured width is not reported as measured width. Core FWHM is raster AA width; halo support is not core width.
method.alphaInversion: dot(rendered-background, coreRGB-background)/squaredNorm(coreRGB-background), clamped0..1; same nativebackground at samepixel
method.color: 8-bit actual rendered core and unchanged background from identical raster pixels; decode display sRGB once to linear sRGB for WCAG luminance ratio and D65 OKLab analysis.
method.unchangedPass: The native Event raster pass, geographic primitive and typed Marker occlusions are reused without shader or native Renderer edits.
